subject.title: Feature Request: Cron Job Hooks System

question: Should OpenClaw core add a persisted cron lifecycle hook/gate API for pre/post/onError execution, including shell and webhook actions, or should this remain limited to command cron and plugin surfaces?
rationale: The remaining work defines public cron config/protocol behavior and unattended code/network execution semantics, which automation cannot choose safely without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve a narrow core hook/gate API
options.body: Define a small additive API with explicit security, timeout, logging, and failure semantics across all cron execution paths.

options.title: Extend plugin hooks first
options.body: Keep cron job config smaller and add decision-capable plugin hooks only if current plugin surfaces cannot express the gate safely.

options.title: Do not add lifecycle hooks
options.body: Treat command cron and observe-only cron_changed as the supported alternatives and close the remaining hook request as out of scope.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow core hook/gate API
recommendation.body: Define a small additive API with explicit security, timeout, logging, and failure semantics across all cron execution paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior issue review and current central-path history make steipete the best available owner for the product/security boundary decision.
